prompt: Which change would address the reason people needed help without making the pump less available?
promptZh: 哪項改變能解決需要協助的原因，又不會減少公用打氣筒的可用時段？
evidence: “The pump stands outside the library and is available all week.” / “People who tried it knew where it was, but couldn’t tell which opening to use.” / “The directions are on a board at the repair stand.” / “That stand is behind a gate that we only open while volunteers are on duty.” / “Whatever we change, people should still be able to use it when we’re not here.”
explanationZh: 使用者找得到打氣筒，問題是看不出要用哪個接孔。把操作說明移近而保留原位置，可同時處理操作和開放條件。

options.text: Move the pump to the repair stand and keep its existing directions.
options.zh: 把打氣筒移到維修站，沿用現有操作說明。
options.whyZh: 搬過去後就能看到操作說明，但維修站的門只有志工在場時才開；這會失去原本整週都可使用的優點。

options.text: Leave the pump outside the library and put the same directions beside it.
options.zh: 讓打氣筒留在圖書館外，並在旁邊放一份相同的操作說明。
options.whyZh: 使用者找得到打氣筒，問題是看不出要用哪個接孔。把操作說明移近而保留原位置，可同時處理操作和開放條件。

options.text: Add more signs showing where the pump is, but leave the operating directions at the stand.
options.zh: 增加指向打氣筒位置的標示，但把操作說明留在維修站。
options.whyZh: 使用者原本就找得到打氣筒；更多位置標示不能幫他們選正確的接孔。

options.text: Keep the pump where it is and ask riders to use it only while volunteers are on duty.
options.zh: 維持打氣筒的位置，請騎士只在志工值勤時使用。
options.whyZh: 限定志工值勤時使用，直接違反講者要在志工不在場時也可使用的要求。
